title: Aurora
summary: A VS Code extension that detects dataset loads inline, profiles them statistically, and generates privacy-safe synthetic data using an auto-selected engine (statistical, Gaussian Copula, or GAN-based), validating output through a multi-stage pipeline. Its CTGANEngine directly imports and fits the standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer as one of the optional generation backends for larger datasets.
evidence: src/utils/generator.py:78: from ctgan import CTGANSynthesizer; line 2118: self._model = CTGANSynthesizer(epochs=300, verbose=False)
needs: CTGAN is an optional dependency (commented out in requirements.txt) with graceful fallback; unclear how often it's actually exercised in practice.
